lane: L3 winner template (l3-i-dont-know), lab H21 (2026-10-03): ONLY the phrase source (rising Google Trends query) and the search-phrase title changed

beats.speech: Don't say because. Say this instead.

card.headline: Since
card.sub: Since it's late, let's go home.

beats.speech: Since. Since it's late, let's go home.

card.headline: As
card.sub: As it was raining, we stayed in.

beats.speech: As. As it was raining, we stayed in.

card.headline: Due to
card.sub: The flight was late due to fog.

beats.speech: Due to. The flight was late due to fog.

card.headline: Thanks to
card.sub: Thanks to you, we finished early.

beats.speech: Thanks to. Thanks to you, we finished early.

card.headline: Seeing as
card.sub: Seeing as you're here, let's start.

beats.speech: Seeing as. Seeing as you're here, let's start.

card.headline: Which one will you try today?

beats.speech: Which one will you try today?

language_approval.notes: Approved unchanged. Since / as / seeing as (informal) take a clause and replace 'because' directly; due to / thanks to replace 'because of' and take a noun - both examples model the noun pattern correctly (due to fog, thanks to you), and the YouTube description carries an explicit noun-only note. Examples grammatical and natural; hook/CTA as template; no caps.
